name: Rimewall Outcrop
description: A black outcrop shouldering out of the snow, its ore frozen into the rock under a skin of rime.

discovery.message: A dark outcrop breaks the snowfield, ore glinting under the frost.

face.text: Frost furs the rock, and every strike rings like a bell. Iron runs through it, and here and there a blue-black seam that looks like it came up from somewhere much deeper.

leave.text: You shoulder your pack and leave the seam behind.
